'''Charl Gedwyn''' was an [[Asha'man]] and the self-appointed [[Tsorovan'm'hael]]. He was one of [[Mazrim Taim]]'s men.

== Appearance ==
Gedwyn was a hard-faced cocky{{ref/book|7|2}} young man, only a few years older than [[Rand]] and of average height. He wore his hair caught back at the nape of his neck with a silver clip.

== Activities ==
He is stopped by Rand before he can kill [[Gawyn Trakand]] from escaping the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]]. Before he can attack Rand, Taim steps in telling him that he is about to attack the [[Dragon Reborn]]. After the battle he is placed in charge of the Aes Sedai prisoners who swore fealty to Rand.

He is placed in Rand's command when Rand drives the [[Seanchan]] away from [[Illian]]. 
He fries [[Eagan Padros]] after Padros's failed assassination attempt on Rand. He convinces Rand to keep advancing on [[Ebou Dar]]. He follows [[Weiramon Saniago]] into the final assault against the Seanchan. He seems to be very friendly with Weiramon for some reason. On arrival back to [[Cairhien]] he, with [[Manel Rochaid]] and [[Corlan Dashiva]] blow up Rand's quarters in an attempt on Rand's life. The attack fails and they are forced to flee. Later Taim reports to Rand that Gedwyn is a deserter.

== Murder ==
Gedwyn was killed, along with [[Peral Torval]], in [[Far Madding]] when [[Padan Fain]] stabbed them with the [[ruby-hilted dagger]] from [[Shadar Logoth]].
